stem: The three stanza breaks in lines 1 through 8 of the poem “Narwhals Are Real” each interrupt a thought the speaker is expressing. How do these interruptions affect the reader?

options.label: A
options.text: By encouraging the reader to respond to the idea expressed in the first part of each thought

options.label: B
options.text: By calling attention to the unexpected completion of each thought

options.label: C
options.text: By creating questions about the reliability of the speaker as a narrator

options.label: D
options.text: By emphasizing the variety of emotions experienced by the speaker
